Photo 0 also shows a second lens (same style) placed beside the camera.
Photo 1 shows the camera from the back/side; rear controls and screen are visible but not readable for condition.

No clear close-up of sensor, shutter count, screen condition, ports, or any included accessories (battery/charger/SD card) is shown.

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lens, but do not provide proof of image sharpness, sensor condition, or overall cleanliness beyond appearance.

risks.risk: The listing may not be only EOS 600D; photo 2 shows another Canon body that appears to be EOS 700D, so the buyer may receive the wrong model or mixed items.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the exact camera model label for the unit being sold (single body only), plus a photo showing the serial number/label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as EOS 600D only, but with risk of mismatch—treated at worst case for buyer value until confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count / wear and possible faults (focus issues, shutter problems, button/port faults) not visible in these photos.
risks.proof: A short video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and a shutter test (multiple shots).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential faults (worst case: not guaranteed fully functional).

risks.risk: Lens condition is not confirmed (fungus, haze, scratches, or internal damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens fronts and rear elements against light, plus a test shot showing flare/contrast.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lenses may be imperfect (worst case: reduced optical quality).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, cables, strap, memory card) can reduce usability/value.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery + charger + any cables + strap + SD card if included).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming key accessories may be missing or not included.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: send a clear close-up photo of the model label for the EOS 600D unit being sold (and ensure photo 2 doesn’t indicate a different body).
Send a photo of the serial number/label and the battery/charger included.
Send close-ups of both lens elements (front and rear) against light to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a short video: power on → menu → autofocus on a moving object → take 5–10 photos → show one image on the screen.
response.reason: The photos identify an EOS 600D in photo 0, but photo 2 suggests a possible mixed-model bundle (EOS 700D visible). Without proof of the exact unit and functional condition (shutter/AF/lens clarity/accessories), a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
